notes: Tap a text for its options, forward texts, and open a contact from their picture.

changes.text: Tap a text to copy, forward, send as new, select, see details, hide or delete it.
Forward one text, or several selected texts, to anyone.
Tap a picture in the inbox or a conversation to open that person in your contacts, or to add a number that is not saved.
Words from a send-SMS link are kept when you already have a conversation with that person.
The app is smaller and starts a little faster after an update.
The app log records more about errors, to help find problems.
